'''Junior Constructed Deck''' is [[Decipher]]'s sanctioned constructed tournament format for players 14 and younger, with its own player rating. Decipher called it Junior Swiss in 1998, the Decipher Junior Tournament Format in 1999, and the Junior tournament in 2000.<ref name="overview98">[http://decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/overview/index.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game: Tournaments], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19980717031138/http://decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/overview/index.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="tg99">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/overview/swtournamentguide/formats.html Tournament Guide, II. Formats], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990502214324/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/overview/swtournamentguide/formats.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="tg00">[http://decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/resources/tournamentguide/tournamenttypesandformats.html Official Tournament Guide, II. Tournament Types and Formats], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000109144553/http://decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/resources/tournamentguide/tournamenttypesandformats.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="ratings99">[http://decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/checkratings/index.html Star Wars CCG: Tournaments – Check Ratings], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991010132916/http://decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/checkratings/index.html Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (by 1998)
* '''Card pool:''' the normal constructed pool; 40-card decks in the 1999 rules
* '''In use:''' 1998 – 2001
* '''Also called:''' Junior Swiss (1998);<ref name="overview98" /> the Decipher Junior Tournament Format (1999);<ref name="tg99" /> Junior (1999–2000)<ref name="tg0699">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/resources/pdfs/tournamentguide0699.pdf Decipher Customizable Card Group Tournament Guide (TD Guide 6.99)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000903022456/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/resources/pdfs/tournamentguide0699.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="tg00" />
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
The May 1999 guide: "The Junior format is exactly the same as the Decipher Swiss format, except for the following differences: Participation is limited to players 14 years old and younger; Deck size is restricted to 40 cards; Timed games are no less than 50 minutes."<ref name="tg99" />

The 2000 guide lists only the age limit: "The Junior tournament is exactly the same as the Constructed Deck format, except for the following differences: Participation is limited to players 14 years old and younger."<ref name="tg00" /> The June 1999 PDF guide words it as "under the age of 15 years old".<ref name="tg0699" />

== History ==
By July 1998 Decipher sanctioned "Swiss, Junior Swiss, and Sealed Deck" and offered a Junior Swiss Command Card.<ref name="overview98" /> Junior results had their own rating: Decipher's ratings page offered "Junior Constructed Deck" in 1999 and still in 2001.<ref name="ratings99" /><ref name="ratings01">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/checkratings Star Wars CCG: Tournaments – Check Ratings], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010508215939/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/checkratings Internet Archive].</ref>
